_about: Dark Haon-Dor (levels 8-20): poisonous spiders that run along the web to each other, the Elder druid of the cultist temple an elite, Isha the Dark Elf a sub-boss, and the Queen spider in her den spawning her brood.

helpers.shout: The web shivers, and spiders come running!

phases.message: The Queen spider shrieks, and the den trembles!

abilities.name: Web Spray
abilities.telegraph: The Queen spider sprays sticky webbing!

abilities.name: Venom Fang
abilities.telegraph: The Queen spider lunges, fangs dripping!

abilities.name: Cocoon
abilities.telegraph: The Queen spider begins spinning a cocoon around you!

bosses.why: the Queen spider in her den

mechanics.shout: Egg sacs split, and poisonous spiders pour out!
